meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. WHEN: event hub SDK error, service bus SDK issue, messaging connection failure, AMQP error, event processor host issue, message lock lost, message lock expired, lock renewal, lock renewal batch, send timeout, receiver disconnected, SDK troubleshooting, azure messaging SDK, event hub consumer, service bus queue issue, topic subscription error, enable logging event hub, service bus logging, eventhub python, servicebus java, eventhub javascript, servicebus dotnet, event hub checkpoint, event hub not receiving messages, service bus dead letter, batch processing lock, session lock expired, idle timeout, connection inactive, link detach, slow reconnect, session error, duplicate events, offset reset, receive batch.

copy.tagline: 排查 Azure 消息服务 SDK 的各类问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're using Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and facing SDK issues.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能诊断和解决 Azure Event Hubs 和 Service Bus SDK 的连接、认证、消息处理等问题，并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你遇到 Azure 消息 SDK 错误、连接失败、认证错误、消息锁丢失或过期、发送超时、接收断开等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 Event Hubs 连接总是超时，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检查资源健康状态并查找文档给出修复步骤。

say.text: Service Bus 消息锁经常过期，如何解决？
say.note: Claude 会分析锁过期原因并建议配置调整。

say.text: 帮我排查 Event Hubs 重复事件的问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查偏移重置和检查点配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can diagnose and resolve issues with Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDKs, including connection failures, authentication errors, message processing problems, and SDK configuration issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you encounter Azure messaging SDK errors, connection failures, authentication errors, message lock lost/expired, send timeout, receiver disconnected, or similar issues.

say_en.text: My Event Hubs connection keeps timing out, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will check resource health and search docs for fixes.

say_en.text: Service Bus message locks expire too often, how to fix?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze lock expiration causes and suggest config changes.

say_en.text: Help me troubleshoot duplicate events in Event Hubs.
say_en.note: Claude will check offset reset and checkpoint settings.
